articles.title: Kraken's xStocks adds 200 UK and EU shares as its assets top $1.1 billion
articles.snippet: Payward says xStocks holds over $1.1 billion. Each token is backed by a share but gives no ownership of the underlying company.

articles.title: Bitcoin stuck under $74,000 as CoreWeave earnings revive AI outlook, Anthropic said to raise IPO valuation
articles.snippet: CoreWeave’s revenue surge lifted AI infrastructure stocks and Nasdaq futures, while bitcoin was little changed over 24 hours.

articles.title: U.S. CPI rose stronger than expected 0.4% in October; core rate rose 0.3%
articles.snippet: A December rate hike appears completely assured, with Fed Governor Chris Waller suggesting even a 50-basis-point move could be appropriate.

articles.title: Bitcoin slips before U.S. inflation report as traders price in Fed rate increase
articles.snippet: Fed Governor Waller backs December tightening even if inflation cools, while falling oil prices offer some relief and Anthropic withdraws IPO pricing details.
